snippet.title: Nightmare Frontier || Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 𝕎𝕀𝕊ℍ𝕃𝕀𝕊𝕋 ℕ𝕆𝕎 on Steam! 🎉
🟣 𝐍𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐫 ► https://bit.ly/Nightmare_Frontier_STEAM 

𝘈𝘣𝘰𝘶𝘵:
Behold the first-ever 𝐓𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐄𝐱𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐋𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐫 where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers. Lead a band of scavenger roughnecks into a devastated boom town of the alternative 1900s. Get in, face the monsters, grab what you can carry and get out. Alive. 👻

𝘋𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘭𝘰𝘱𝘦𝘳:
🧊 Ice Code Games 🧊

𝘜𝘴𝘦𝘧𝘶𝘭 𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘬𝘴:
📌 https://linktr.ee/ice_code_games 🌳
📌 https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb 👾

ʜᴀꜱʜᴛᴀɢꜱ:
#EarlyAccess #TurnBasedCombat #Western
